description: Comprehensive BSE and NSE audit services for stock brokers, trading members, clearing members, depository participants, mutual funds, RTAs and capital market entities. SEBI-compliant IT governance, cybersecurity controls and operational resilience assessments.

mainEntity.name: Is BSE/NSE audit mandatory in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, SEBI mandates periodic IT and cybersecurity audits for applicable capital market entities including stock brokers, trading members, clearing members and depository participants.

mainEntity.name: How often should BSE/NSE audits be conducted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically annually, or as specified by SEBI and exchange circulars. Entities should also conduct audits after significant system changes or security incidents.

mainEntity.name: Does ISECURION follow SEBI and exchange formats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all reports are prepared in alignment with prescribed SEBI, BSE and NSE formats and guidelines for regulatory submission.

mainEntity.name: Can you help with pre-audit readiness?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer gap assessments and readiness reviews to identify control weaknesses before the formal audit engagement.
Yes, we assist with closure of audit findings through remediation guidance, implementation support and validation testing.

mainEntity.name: Are cloud systems included in scope?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, both cloud-based and on-premises environments are covered as per SEBI guidelines for technology infrastructure.
Yes, incident response readiness, procedures and regulatory reporting mechanisms are key audit focus areas.

mainEntity.name: Will the audit impact daily operations?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, audits are carefully planned and executed to minimize disruption to trading and business operations.
Yes, vendor and third-party risk management is assessed where mandated by SEBI guidelines.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically 2 to 6 weeks depending on organization size, complexity and scope of systems covered.
